_说明: universal-mock-exam 的试卷数据格式。build_exam.py 与 score_exam.py 都读这个文件。注意：本文件只演示字段形状，仅含两道样题，数值不构成完整试卷，直接运行会因题量/分值不匹配而报错——先按你的考试补全 sections 与 questions。

exam.name: 示例考试
exam.basis: 官方资料 3 份 + 民间情报 6 条；预测性内容占比 0%
instructions: 本卷满分 300 分，考试时间 120 分钟。
客观题直接填写选项字母；主观题用英文作答，分点陈述。

sections.title: Section A 中国文化知识

questions.stem: You are preparing a gift for an Italian business partner. Which is the safest choice?
options: A. A set of sharp kitchen knives.
B. A gift with no price tag attached.
C. Flowers in an even number, wrapped in purple.
questions.explanation: Italian gift etiquette: avoid sharp objects, purple wrapping, chrysanthemums (funeral flowers) and visible price tags.
questions.distractors: A 触犯'刀剪断交'禁忌；C 紫色与偶数花束均不吉；D 菊花用于葬礼。

questions.stem: During a business trip you happen to be in Myanmar on the day of the Thingyan festival. Your local colleague invites you to join the celebration. What would you do, and why?
questions.reference: Accept with curiosity, ask about the etiquette, respect local customs, and treat the invitation as a relationship signal rather than a tour.

rubric.point: 表达参与意愿或开放态度

questions.common_errors: 直接回答 I would not go because I am busy——与考试倡导的开放、好奇、尊重背道而驰。
